name: Comment (tickets)
xml:
<field
	type="editor"
	name="comment"
	label="Comment"
	description="Provide a clear and concise comment about this ticket. You may write in plain text or use basic Markdown formatting (e.g., italic, bold, code). Maximum length: 2,000 characters. No tables allowed."
	message="Error: Your comment is too long or includes unsupported formatting. Please enter up to 2,000 characters using plain text or Markdown only.
"
	width="100%"
	height="400"
	maxlength="2000"
	buttons="false"
	syntax="markdown"
	editor="codemirror|none"
	filter="STRING"
	required="true"
	validate="maxlength"
/>
